context: Evaluates whether the candidate correctly uses the useAddItem mutation hook from @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce to add products to the cart. Tests knowledge of the mutation hook pattern, correct argument shape ({ productId, variantId, quantity }), and appropriate UI state management during the async operation.

checklist.name: Uses useAddItem hook
checklist.description: The component imports and calls useAddItem from the cart module of @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce, not a generic fetch or custom API call.

checklist.name: Correct argument shape
checklist.description: The mutation function is called with an object containing productId, variantId, and quantity matching the hook's expected input.

checklist.name: Loading state disables button
checklist.description: During the async mutation, the button is disabled and shows a different label (e.g., 'Adding...').

checklist.name: Error handling
checklist.description: Errors from the mutation are caught and displayed to the user, not silently swallowed.

checklist.name: Default quantity
checklist.description: The component uses a default quantity of 1 when the prop is not provided.
